title: Trail ring push/shift invariants untested anywhere
detail: P2 gap: ring ordering (oldest [0], newest [2]), capacity handoff, and the 0.5px moved-gate are pinned by no @(test) and no golden (trails never render at alpha=1.0). A shift regression mis-orders or smears echoes silently.
recommended_fix: Unit-test via packet_interp_pos across ≥4 consecutive pushes: assert trail_n ≤ 3, slot order oldest→newest, and that a stationary packet pushes nothing.

title: Reduced-motion echo-off gate is unreachable by every automated gate — a11y_reduced golden cannot exercise it
detail: P2 gap: the E9.2/7.3 canon contract (echoes off, glide stays) is only exercisable via manual `motion-strip` of an a11y demo; the a11y_reduced T2 golden pins pulse_read's reduced path only, never the trail branch.
recommended_fix: Add a unit assertion of the draw predicate (trail_n>0 && !reduced_motion), or gate a motion-strip a11y_reduced interp run asserting zero echo pixels appear.

title: packet_interp_prune bound and run-start cache reset have no coverage
detail: P3 gap: the monotonic-id row bound and the stale-row reset across runs are app-path hygiene with no test; a prune regression grows the map unboundedly in long sessions.
recommended_fix: Extend the motion unit test: prune keeps only live ids and no-ops under threshold; reset empties the map.
